final_payload.rationale_summary: Computed the growth in imports goods and services from 2006-12-31 to 2007-12-31 for Netherlands and Saudi Arabia. The growth for Saudi Arabia was higher, resulting in a difference of approximately 8.297 percentage points. The result was verified against cross-check evidence.
